resources.string: Confirms when a screenshot or shared image is saved.
Shown while Memora files and understands images in the background.
Takes a screenshot only when you tap the Memora tile.

Memora uses this service for one thing: when you tap the Memora tile in Quick Settings, it saves a screenshot of the current screen to Memora. The service doesn\'t receive accessibility events or read window content, and it never takes a screenshot unless you tap the tile.
Something went wrong while taking the screenshot. Try again.
Nothing to save. Memora only accepts images.
